page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Paragraphs begin with numbered items (9 to 13) and each stands as its own paragraph.
page.running_head: In Bellar. Controv. vi. de pvrg.

main_text.p: flamma repellat.] de igne quidem agit Lactantius eo in loco; sed non de Purgatorio Pontificio antecedente resurrectione vltimumq; iudicium Dei. vide supra lib. 1. cap. 10. nota 66. itemque de loco Ambrosij ibidem nota 43. Ruperti authoritatem reiicimus.

9. Art.9. alios vero magis minusve exuri, prout plus minusve materia combustibilis afferebant.] Furfæus ille, si non dormiens, saltem vigilans somniauit μελαγχολῶν[?]. negamus ista, & conclusionem sequentem.
10. Art. 16. damnatos puniendos quidem, sed tamen citra condignum.] de hac exceptione Bellarminus ipse viderit.
11. Art 24. vt indicet se loqui solum de piis Christianis.] vide supra cap.10. nota 52. & 62. in librum primum. Nam hæ solutiones, quas Bellarminus adfert, abludunt à mente Hieronymi.

12. Artic. 26. multa requirit ad iustificationem impij praeter eleemosynā.] ambigue dictum. Nam ad iustificationem impij coram Deo præstandam nihil requiritur nisi iustitia Christi iustificantis impium, Rom 3. quam Christianus sentit & prehendit fide: sed ad iustificationem testandam coram Deo & hominibus desiderantur multa. Sed de hac re in tomo 4. Quamobrem sequentia nihil ad rem.
13. Art.29.(@) aliis locis supra citatis.] nempe lib. 1. cap. 5. & 7. Nos vero sententiam istam veram negamus esse, & distinctiones probationéf-que illius.

page.notes: The Greek word in item 9 (μελαγχολῶν) is uncertain. The scan is faint, so the reading is marked [?]. The reference mark in item 13 (@) is an uncertain symbol. The line break "probationéf-" / "que" is kept as printed. Item 13 is the last line of the page and is followed by no catchword or signature.
